# Rating

**Class:** `UltraCanvasRating` · **Group:** [Buttons and choices](../Groups/Buttons-and-choices.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasRating.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasRating.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasRating.h"`

## What it is for

A score out of N

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRating> CreateRating( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, int maxRating = 5, float value = 0.0f);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRating> CreateHalfRating( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, int maxRating = 5, float value = 0.0f);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasRating> CreateVectorRating( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h, const std::string& onPath, const std::string& offPath, const std::string& halfPath = "", int maxRating = 5);   // Rating that renders from vector/image files for its on/off/half states.
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasRating(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasRating(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasRating(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onRatingChanged` | `std::function<void(float)> onRatingChanged` | committed value |
| `onHoverChanged` | `std::function<void(float)> onHoverChanged` | live hover value (-1 when cleared) |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `RatingSymbol`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Star` | classic 5-point star |
| `Circle` | filled dot |
| `Square` | rounded square |
| `Custom` | user-supplied image / SVG files (see SetCustomSymbols) |

### struct `RatingStyle`

| Field | Declaration | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `onColor` | `Color onColor = Color(255, 179, 0, 255)` | filled (amber) |
| `offColor` | `Color offColor = Color(214, 214, 220, 255)` | empty (light grey) |
| `hoverColor` | `Color hoverColor = Color(255, 202, 64, 255)` | filled while hovering |
| `borderColor` | `Color borderColor = Color(198, 150, 0, 255)` | optional outline |
| `borderWidth` | `float borderWidth = 0.0f` | 0 = no outline on built-in shapes |
| `symbolSize` | `float symbolSize = 28.0f` |  |
| `spacing` | `float spacing = 4.0f` |  |
| `tintCustom` | `bool tintCustom = false` | When drawing Custom symbols, treat the image as a monochrome mask and tint it with the state colour (via DrawMask) instead of drawing the image's own colours. Leave false for full-colour SVG icons. |
| `fontStyle` | `FontStyle fontStyle` |  |
